data.narrative:
Scout AI is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Colby Adcock and Collin Otis that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—operating in the same sector and at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $15M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $38M. The peer-median method examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). This produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $32M to $460M, with a median of $219M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Scout AI's profile aligns more closely with the upper tier of the peer set (UFORCE at $1.0B) or the lower end (NODA AI at $125M). Key unknowns include the company's current traction metrics, competitive differentiation, and customer pipeline depth relative to the peer universe. The stage-progression method's conservative result suggests significant value creation expectations embedded in peer valuations.
